blocks.text: Yeh chapter 10 (Human Respiratory System) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, farq, structure ki tafseel, misalein), aik 4 number ka hissa ya 1+3 / 2+2 ke chhote hisson mein. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Explain how each property of the respiratory surface helps the diffusion of gases. (4 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke respiratory surface ki har khususiyat gases ke diffusion mein kaise madad deti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Respiratory surface woh jagah hai jahan mahol aur khoon ke darmiyan diffusion se asal gas tabadla hota hai. Insanon mein oxygen hawa se khoon mein aur CO₂ khoon se hawa mein diffuse hoti hai. Is ki khususiyaat aur faida:

1. Geela aur permeable: taa ke gases is se guzar sakein.
2. Patla: taa ke gases ko kam se kam faasla tay karna pare.
3. Khoon ki supply: taa ke gases khoon mein aa ja sakein.
4. Structural support: taa ke yeh khula rahe aur pichke nahi.
5. Andar waqe: taa ke is ki geeli satah hawa ko pani na khoye.
6. Hawa is par ventilate hoti hai: hawa is ki taraf aati aur door jati hai.
7. Hawa shakhdar nalyon se guzar kar pahunchti hai: taa ke pahunchne se pehle paani ke bukharat se bhar jaye.

book_ref.quote: The following properties enable respiratory surfaces for effective diffusion of gases across them

blocks.prompt:
2 Describe the structure and functions of the nasal cavity and the pharynx. (4 marks)
(Nasal cavity aur pharynx ki banawat aur kaam bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Nasal cavity:
1. Nostrils (naak ke bahar ke suraakh) nasal cavity mein khulte hain; yeh naak ke peechhe hawa bhari bari jagah hai jise nasal septum do hisson mein baant-ta hai.
2. Satah ke bilkul qareeb khoon ki naliyan saans ki hawa ko garam aur nam karti hain.
3. Naak ke baal aur mucous membranes ka mucus bare zarraat ko andar jane se pehle phansa lete hain.
4. Is mein soonghne ke liye chemoreceptors bhi hain jo zaiqe mein bhi hissa dalte hain.

Pharynx:
1. Nali numa banawat jo nasal aur oral cavities ko larynx aur oesophagus se jorti hai.
2. Hawa aur khurak dono is se guzarte hain, is liye yeh respiratory aur digestive dono systems ka hissa hai.
3. Hawa nasal cavity se pharynx ke raste larynx tak (aur ulta) aur khurak munh se pharynx ke raste oesophagus tak jati hai.

book_ref.quote: It is a tube-like structure that connects the nasal cavity and oral cavity to larynx and oesophagus

blocks.prompt:
3 Describe the larynx. Explain how the epiglottis and the cough reflex protect the air passage. (4 marks)
(Larynx bayan karein. Wazahat karein ke epiglottis aur khansi ka reflex hawa ke raste ki hifazat kaise karte hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Larynx:
1. Yeh pharynx aur trachea ko jorta hai aur muscles aur cartilages se bana hai.
2. Ise voice box kehte hain kyun ke is mein do bands, vocal cords, hain jo hawa guzarne par thartharate aur awaz banate hain.
3. Kuch muscles vocal cords ko door kar ke saans ka rasta dete hain; doosre unhein qareeb la kar awaz banate aur pitch aur volume control karte hain.

Epiglottis: cartilage ka dhakkan jo glottis (larynx ke munh) ke aage aur oopar hai. Hawa jate waqt yeh oopar khari rehti hai. Nigalte waqt zuban ki peechhe ki harkat larynx ko uthati hai aur epiglottis neeche ho kar glottis band kar deti hai, is tarah nigla hua maadda larynx mein nahi jata.

Khansi ka reflex: agar nigla hua maadda phir bhi larynx mein jane lage to larynx chhirta hai aur taqatwar khansi ka reflex use larynx se nikal kar gale mein bhej deta hai.

book_ref.quote: The larynx connects the pharynx and trachea

blocks.prompt:
4 Describe the structure of the trachea and the branching of the bronchial tree up to the alveoli. (4 marks)
(Trachea ki banawat aur bronchial tree ki alveoli tak shakhon ko bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Trachea (saans ki nali):
1. Larynx ko lungs se jorti hai; sab se chaura rasta, taqreeban 1 inch chauri aur 4–6 inch lambi.
2. Is ki deewarein smooth muscles aur C-shaped cartilage rings se bani hain jo taqat aur sahara de kar rasta khula rakhti hain.
3. Andar mucus aur cilia hain; cilia mucus mein phanse zarraat ko pharynx ki taraf dhakelte hain.
4. Neeche ja kar yeh do bronchi mein bant jati hai.

Bronchial tree:
1. Daayan aur baayan primary bronchus lungs mein ja kar secondary bronchi banate hain: baayen lung mein do aur daayen mein teen. Secondary bronchi mein C-shaped cartilages ki jagah cartilage plates hoti hain.
2. Secondary bronchi tertiary bronchi mein aur woh bohat chhote bronchioles mein bant-te hain jin mein cartilage plates nahi.
3. Bronchioles kai baar bant kar terminal bronchioles bante hain jo alveolar ducts mein khatam hote hain.
4. Alveolar ducts chhoti hawai thailiyon, alveoli, ke guchhon par khatam hoti hain jahan gas tabadla hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The trachea, or windpipe, connects the larynx to the lungs for the passage of air

blocks.prompt:
5 Describe the lungs with reference to the pleura, lobes, alveolar clusters and surfactant. (4 marks)
(Lungs ko pleura, lobes, alveoli ke guchhon aur surfactant ke hawale se bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Lungs: respiratory tract ke sab se bare organs.
2. Pleura: har lung do membranes se dhaka hai. Visceral pleura lungs par aur parietal pleura thoracic cavity ki andaruni deewar par. Darmiyan ki chhoti pleural cavity fluid se bhari hai jo saans ke dauran lungs ko aazadi se phailne aur sukarne deti hai.
3. Lobes: daayan lung bara aur teen lobes wala; baayan chhota aur do lobes wala jo dil ke liye jagah chhorta hai.
4. Alveoli ke guchhe: har alveolar duct 20-30 alveoli ke guchhe mein khulti hai jo capillaries se ghira hai; yeh guchhe lung ka zyada hissa hain. Alveolus sirf 0.1 micrometre moti geeli epithelial tissue hai aur dono lungs mein 700 million tak alveoli ho sakte hain jo bohat bari satah dete hain.
5. Surfactant: alveoli ke kuch cells surfactant banate hain jo alveoli ke andar ho kar hawa nikalne par unhein pichakne aur chipakne se rokta hai; sehatmand lungs mein yeh musalsal banta aur jazb hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The lungs are the largest organs of the respiratory tract

blocks.prompt:
6 Answer the following about breathing: (i) How is breathing controlled by the brain? (ii) Why is breathing harder at high altitudes, and how are birds able to breathe efficiently there? (4 marks)
(Saans ke baare mein: (i) Dimagh saans ko kaise control karta hai? (ii) Oonchai par saans mushkil kyun hai, aur parinde wahan behtar saans kaise lete hain?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Saans ka control: har saans medulla oblongata (brain stem ka hissa) ke respiratory centre ke neurons shuru karte hain. Yeh diaphragm aur intercostal muscles ko impulses bhejte hain jo sukar kar inspiration karte hain. Jab neurons impulses band karte hain to muscles dheele hote hain aur expiration hoti hai.

(ii) Oonchai: wahan fazai pressure kam hai, is liye lungs ka pressure fazai se kam karne ke liye thorax ko zyada phailna parta hai. Isi liye saans mushkil hai. Jism oxygen behtar lene ke tareeqe apna leta hai, isi liye athletes muqablon se pehle oonchai par training karte hain.
Parinde: in mein lungs ke saath air sacs hain. Hawa aik rukh mein behti hai: bahar → posterior air sacs → lungs → anterior air sacs → bahar. Hawa khoon ke bahao ke ulat behti hai, is liye gas tabadla bohat behtar hai aur kam oxygen wali oonchai par bhi kaafi oxygen milti hai.

book_ref.quote: Each breath is initiated by neurons in a respiratory centre

blocks.prompt:
7 Explain the oxygen reserve of the blood at rest and during exercise, and the effect of pH and temperature on haemoglobin's affinity for oxygen. (4 marks)
(Aaram aur warzish mein khoon ki oxygen reserve, aur haemoglobin ki oxygen se raghbat par pH aur temperature ka asar samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Aaram mein: lungs se nikalne wala khoon 97% oxyhaemoglobin hai. Tissues se nikalne wale venous khoon ka PO₂ kam (40 mm Hg) aur saturation 75% hai. Is liye sirf 22% (97% − 75%) oxyhaemoglobin oxygen deta hai aur 75% reserve rehta hai. Yeh reserve warzish aur aaram dono mein zaroorat poori karta hai aur saans ya dil rukne par chaar paanch minute zindagi qaim rakhne layak oxygen rakhta hai.

Warzish mein: muscles zyada oxygen lete hain, venous PO₂ 20 mm Hg aur saturation 75% se 35% ho jati hai. Arterial khoon ab bhi 97% hai, is liye 22% ki bajaye 62% (97% − 35%) oxygen utarti hai.

pH (Bohr effect): tissues ki CO₂ khoon ka pH kam karti hai. Kam pH haemoglobin ki oxygen se raghbat kam karta hai aur woh oxygen aasani se chhorta hai.

Temperature: temperature barhne ka bhi yahi asar hai. Warzish mein skeletal muscles zyada heat banate hain, is liye haemoglobin zyada feesad oxygen chhorta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab reserve ko 78% likhti hai, magar 97% − 22% = 75%. Is liye aaram ki halat mein reserve 75% hai.

blocks.prompt:
8 Answer the following: (i) What is carbaminohaemoglobin, and why do CO₂ and O₂ not compete for haemoglobin? (ii) Describe the cause, mechanism and symptoms of carbon monoxide poisoning. (4 marks)
(Yeh jawab dein: (i) Carbaminohaemoglobin kya hai, aur CO₂ aur O₂ haemoglobin ke liye muqabla kyun nahi karte? (ii) Carbon monoxide poisoning ki wajah, tareeqa aur alamaat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Taqreeban 20% CO₂ haemoglobin ki globin (protein) chains se jur kar jati hai; yeh compound carbaminohaemoglobin hai. CO₂ haemoglobin ke protein hisse se aur O₂ haem iron se judti hai, is liye dono gases haemoglobin ke liye muqabla nahi karti. (Carboxyhaemoglobin carbon monoxide se juda haemoglobin hai.)

(ii) Wajah: lakri, gasoline, propane ya natural gas jaise fuels ke adhoore jalne se CO banti hai; maslan band kamre mein raat bhar jalte gas heater se CO jama ho jati hai.
Tareeqa: saans se andar gayi CO haemoglobin se oxygen ke muqable mein bohat zyada raghbat se judti hai. Oxygen le jane wala haemoglobin kam ho jata hai aur tissue hypoxia (oxygen ki kami) hota hai.
Alamaat: sar dard, chakkar, kamzori, matli, ulajhan, saans phoolna, seene mein dard aur behoshi. Sangeen soorat mein dimagh ko mustaqil nuqsan aur maut bhi.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab CO₂ wale haemoglobin ko 'carboxyhaemoglobin' kehti hai; yeh ghalat hai. CO₂ + globin = carbaminohaemoglobin; CO + haemoglobin = carboxyhaemoglobin.

blocks.prompt:
9 What are respiratory pigments? Describe the structure and role of myoglobin in muscles. (4 marks)
(Respiratory pigments kya hain? Muscles mein myoglobin ki banawat aur kirdar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Respiratory pigments: khoon ya tissues ke khaas proteins jo jism mein oxygen le jate hain. Yeh O₂ jama karna, CO₂ le jana aur doosri cheezein le jana bhi karte hain. Do mashhoor respiratory pigments haemoglobin aur myoglobin hain.

Myoglobin:
1. Vertebrates ke skeletal aur cardiac muscle cells ka oxygen pakarne wala protein; muscles ko khaas surkh ya gehra surmai rang deta hai.
2. Aik monomer jis ki aik polypeptide chain 153 amino acids ki aur aik haem group hai, is liye sirf aik O₂ pakarta hai.
3. Is ki oxygen se raghbat haemoglobin se zyada hai, is liye yeh muscles mein oxygen jama karne wala protein hai.
4. Oxygen ka partial pressure 20 mm Hg se kam hone par oxygen chhorta hai (haemoglobin PO₂ 60 mm Hg par). Is tarah zaroorat par muscles ko oxygen deta hai.

book_ref.quote: The two well-known respiratory pigments are haemoglobin and myoglobin

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab myoglobin ki chain ko 'polynucleotide' likhti hai; yeh ghalat hai. Polynucleotide DNA aur RNA hote hain. Myoglobin protein hai, is ki chain polypeptide hai.

blocks.prompt:
10 Describe the cause, symptoms and treatment of otitis media. (4 marks)
(Otitis media ki wajah, alamaat aur ilaj bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Otitis media: darmiyani kaan ki soojan. Yeh acute (achanak shuru) ya chronic (chhe hafton se zyada) ho sakti hai.

Wajah: Eustachian tube mein fluid ka jama hona jo darmiyani kaan se nikal na sake. Yeh fluid na nikle to darmiyani kaan mein bacteria aur virus barhte hain aur otitis media hoti hai.

Alamaat: kaan mein shadeed dard, aik ya dono kaan khenchna, bukhar, kaan se fluid behna, tawazun bigarna aur sunne mein mushkil.

Ilaj: munh se khane aur lagane wali dard ki dawaiyan, aur bacteria ki wajah se ho to antibiotics.

book_ref.quote: Symptoms of otitis media include severe ear pain, pulling at one or both ears, fever

blocks.prompt:
13 Describe the causes, symptoms and treatment of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). (4 marks)
(Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) ki wujoohaat, alamaat aur ilaj bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
COPD: lungs ki chronic soojan wali bimari. Chronic bronchitis aur emphysema is ki qismein hain.

Wujoohaat: tambaku noshi, nuqsandeh aaloodgi aur chemical fumes ka lamba samna. Thora hissa genetic rujhan (protein alpha-1 antitrypsin ki kami) se, cigarette ya aaloodgi ke baghair bhi.

Alamaat: musalsal balgham (sputum) wali khansi, saans phoolna, wheezing (saans mein seeti), seene mein jakran (chest tightness), thakan aur baar baar respiratory infections.

Ilaj: COPD la-ilaj hai, magar dhuen, aaloodgi aur chemicals se bachao is ki raftar kam karta hai. Doosri therapies: bronchodilators, inhaled corticosteroids, pulmonary rehabilitation aur oxygen therapy. Kuch sangeen cases mein lung transplantation ki surgery.

book_ref.quote: The common causes of COPD are tobacco smoking, long terms exposure to harmful pollutants and chemical fumes

(COPD ki do qismon, chronic bronchitis aur emphysema, ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono COPD ki qismein hain aur alamaat milti julti hain, lekin yeh lungs ke mukhtalif hisson ko nuqsan dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Emphysema is a type of COPD
